comment: AuruMask persona mapping. Edit and redeploy — no code changes needed. Gains scale raw blendshape coefficients before they hit the model; unlisted shapes default to 1.0. Spring constants: stiffness is the spring constant k (pull toward rest, 1/s^2), damping is the velocity drag c (1/s). Metal whiskers = high stiffness, low damping (they ring); furry ears = moderate stiffness, higher damping (they settle).
